title.zh: 币安因 SignalPlus 潜在安全问题删除其关联 API 密钥
title.en: Binance revokes SignalPlus-linked API keys over potential security issue

current_state.zh: 在第三方期权交易平台 SignalPlus 报告潜在安全问题后，币安移除了所有与该平台关联的 API 密钥，并表示自身系统和用户资金未受影响。
current_state.en: Binance removed all API keys linked to third-party options trading platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, saying its own systems and user funds were unaffected.

updates.title_zh: 【币安：已删除所有与 SignalPlus 关联的 API 密钥，作为一项紧急预防措施】
updates.title_en: 【币安：已删除所有与 SignalPlus 关联的 API 密钥，作为一项紧急预防措施】
updates.what_changed_zh: 在SignalPlus报告潜在安全问题后，币安主动删除了与该第三方期权平台关联的所有API密钥，称自身系统及用户资金未受影响，并建议用户在问题完全解决后再重新绑定密钥，同时启用IP白名单。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance proactively deleted all API keys associated with third-party options platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, stating its own systems and user funds were unaffected and advising users to re-bind keys only once the problem is fully resolved, with IP whitelisting enabled.
updates.current_state_zh: 在SignalPlus报告潜在安全问题后，币安主动删除了与该第三方期权平台关联的所有API密钥，称自身系统及用户资金未受影响，并建议用户在问题完全解决后再重新绑定密钥，同时启用IP白名单。
updates.current_state_en: Binance proactively deleted all API keys associated with third-party options platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, stating its own systems and user funds were unaffected and advising users to re-bind keys only once the problem is fully resolved, with IP whitelisting enabled.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance proactively deleted all API keys associated with third-party options platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, stating its own systems and user funds were unaffected and advising users to re-bind keys only once the problem is fully resolved, with IP whitelisting enabled.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance proactively deleted all API keys associated with third-party options platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, stating its own systems and user funds were unaffected and advising users to re-bind keys only once the problem is fully resolved, with IP whitelisting enabled.

updates.title_zh: 币安、Deribit在安全问题后撤销SignalPlus API密钥
updates.title_en: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after security issue
updates.what_changed_zh: Deribit 也已预防性撤销与 SignalPlus 关联的 API 密钥，并称未发现其系统或数据受到影响；两家交易所均建议用户检查持仓和未成交订单，等待 SignalPlus 确认问题解决后再重新连接。
updates.what_changed_en: Deribit also proactively revoked SignalPlus-linked API keys, saying it found no indication of impact on its systems or data; both exchanges advised users to review positions and open orders and wait for SignalPlus to confirm remediation before reconnecting.
updates.current_state_zh: 因 SignalPlus 报告潜在安全问题，币安和 Deribit 均已预防性撤销与其关联的 API 密钥；两家交易所称自身系统与用户资金未受影响，用户被建议在 SignalPlus 确认问题解决前暂缓重新连接。
updates.current_state_en: After SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, both Binance and Deribit proactively revoked SignalPlus-linked API keys; both said their systems and user funds were unaffected and advised users to wait for SignalPlus to confirm remediation before reconnecting.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance and Deribit proactively revoked all API keys tied to third-party trading platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, telling users to review positions and open orders and to hold off reconnecting until the platform confirms remediation.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance and Deribit proactively revoked all API keys tied to third-party trading platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, telling users to review positions and open orders and to hold off reconnecting until the platform confirms remediation.
